scope: 20 independent fixed-share single-symbol studies; not a portfolio backtest
limitations: Current selected universe; survivorship and selection bias
Four stocks, including two banks; no broad universe or independent out-of-sample validation
Price returns exclude dividend income and cash interest
Ten shares per request, so invested exposure differs by symbol
Non-dividend corporate actions rejected over warm-up and study window
Open positions marked, not realized or force-closed
V1 baseline trailing disabled; engine trailing support tested separately
Study entry-day protection and unclipped market slippage differ from legacy paper eligibility/clipping; full parity gate remains open

assumptions.entry: previous final signal -> next session open plus adverse slippage
assumptions.exits: entry-day protection; stop first on double touch; trail effective next session
assumptions.slippage: paper adverse rounding; no favourable clipping to later daily high/low
assumptions.liquidity: shared daily participation budget; partial exit remainder at next opens
assumptions.end_policy: open positions marked at final close, no forced sale
assumptions.price_basis: NSE as-traded; price return excludes dividends; non-dividend actions rejected
